Mod.Name: Off the Books: Water Expanded Compatibility
Mod.Author: RnK Gaming
Mod.Description: Lets Water Expanded's devices work on Shop Expansion's shelves and in the back room, including inside containers that stand there. It corrects, in memory, Water Expanded's test of where a device stands; it changes none of that mod's files and adds no items or saved data. Needs Water Expanded; the shelves also need Shop Expansion, and the back room works with Water Expanded alone.
